provenance.buildNote: Single-program WASI build (minimap2 v2.31) via wasi-sdk 25, build/minimap2/Dockerfile. SSE2 alignment kernels (ksw2_*_sse.c) ported through SIMDe 0.8.2 with -msimd128 (SSE2-only path, SIMDE_FLOAT16_API=PORTABLE); upstream kthread.c (which calls pthread_create unconditionally) is replaced by a synchronous single-threaded kthread_wasi.c, and -t is forced to 1. zlib 1.3.1 cross-compiled from source; getrusage via wasi-emulated-process-clocks (stderr timing only; peakrss neutralized). LICENSE is verbatim MIT (GitHub shows NOASSERTION due to a custom header line 'The MIT License'). Two-input wiring: reference materialized as a file in the preopened dir (argsTemplate {reference} placeholder), query streamed via stdin (-). wasm PAF matches the native-captured golden byte-for-byte.
